concepts.name: Polynomial Function
concepts.simple_definition: A polynomial function is a function of the form f(x) = a_n x^n + ... + a_1 x + a_0, where n is a non-negative integer.
concepts.deep_explanation: The leading coefficient a_n cannot be zero, and n represents the degree of the polynomial. The domain of any polynomial function is all real numbers.
concepts.real_example: f(x) = 3x³ - 5x + 2 is a polynomial function of degree 3.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking functions with negative exponents (like x⁻¹) or fractional exponents (like x^1/2) are polynomials.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ፖሊኖሚያል ፈንክሽን ማለት የf(x) = a_n x^n + ... + a_0 ቅርጽ ያለው ፈንክሽን ሲሆን፣ ገላጮቹ ኢ-አሉታዊ ሙሉ ቁጥሮች ናቸው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: የመጀመሪያው ረዳት ቁጥር (leading coefficient) 0 መሆን የለበትም፣ n ደግሞ የፖሊኖሚያሉን ዲግሪ ያሳያል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: አሉታዊ ገላጭ (x⁻¹) ወይም ክፍልፋይ ገላጭ (x^1/2) ያላቸውን ፈንክሽኖች ፖሊኖሚያል ናቸው ብሎ ማሰብ ስህተት ነው።
